name: Engineering Works (Orgrimmar)
summary: The Engineering Works is a workshop tucked away in the rear of the goblin sector within Orgrimmar. It provides a hub for tinkerers and inventors looking to work with volatile mechanical crafts under the watchful gaze of the Horde.

sections.title: A Spark in the Valley
sections.body: Situated amidst the clanking metal and sulfur smells of the Horde capital, the Engineering Works serves as a small shop for practitioners of engineering. Goblin tinkerers and visiting crafters gather here to assemble gears, solder copper wiring, and calibrate unpredictable ordnance away from the crowded thoroughfares of the Valley of Strength.

faq.answer: It is a specialized workshop and engineering shop located in Orgrimmar, offering a space for artisans and inventors to craft mechanical items and tinker with explosives.
It can be found tucked away in the goblin engineering quarters of Orgrimmar, nestled behind neighboring stone and timber structures away from the central traffic of the city.
Goblin engineers and tinkerers oversee the workshop, maintaining anvils, tools, and worktables suited for both delicate schematics and dangerous ordnance.

angles.text: The Engineering Works offers a local place in the capital to find tools, parts, and inspiration among fellow mechanical practitioners.
Goblin ingenuity supports the Horde war effort with everything from basic tools to lethal sapper charges crafted in workshops like this one.
